You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: How long will an O'Reilly license stay active before it is automatically revoked for an Engineering team member?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): The license is removed after three months.

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
Teams around GitLab utilize other training providers for accessing role specific training courses and learning materials. This handbook page lists the different providers used, including details on access and licensing.

## O'Reilly Learning

The O'Reilly Learning library, contains thousands of books, videos and live learning courses to assist team members with professional development and staying up-to-date with changing technology trends. Additionally, code sandboxes are included within the O'Reilly platform that team members can utilize to practice new skills or hone existing ones.

### How to get an O'Reilly license

O'Reilly is funded by Engineering, so is currently only available for Engineering team members please request access via [Lumos](/handbook/security/corporate/systems/lumos/ar/). Please note, seats are very limited, so you may need to wait until one becomes available.

To ensure seats and licenses are used effectively, access will be removed after 3 months to reallocate

seats/licenses to other users. If you would like access again in the future, you can re-request it.

If you're outside of Engineering and would like an O'Reilly license, you can purchase one using the [G&D Fund](/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/).

### Accessing O'Reilly content

Once you have an active license, we have a content integration set up in [LevelUp](https://levelup.edcast.com/), so you can find and filter O'Reilly content using the search function, alongside all our other self-paced learning materials.

You can also access via the [O'Reilly platform](https://www.oreilly.com/online-learning/) directly.

## Google Cloud Skills Boost Learning

As a GCP Partner, GitLab has a number of seats to Google Cloud's [Skills Boost Platform for Partners](https://partner.cloudskillsboost.google/catalog). This portal includes a wide array of learning materials related to Google Cloud's offerings, ranging from introductory to advanced.

Many teams work to deprovision access including the IT Operations, this should be regarded as urgent and all tasks expected to be completed within 5 working days (Child Cases close automatically after 5 days), with the exception of [laptop returns](/handbook/eta/corporate-it/end-user-services/laptop-management/), which can take 2-4 weeks.

**Note:** If the team member is temporarily transitioning to a [contractor or consultant role](/handbook/finance/procurement/contingent-worker-policy/), please proceed with the full offboarding process and create a separate onboarding issue to grant only specific temporary access for what they would need to fulfill their contractual obligations.
